claim: VulnGNN identifies vulnerable basic blocks in stripped binaries without debug symbols or source code.
evidence: 5-seed test mean ROC-AUC of 0.9543 ± 0.0022, PR-AUC of 0.2739 ± 0.0085, F1-score of 0.3006 ± 0.0059, Top-1 Hit Rate of 49.81% ± 1.83%, Top-5 Hit Rate of 83.56% ± 0.56% on 819 held-out test binaries.
independent_verification: Verified via 10,000-resample paired bootstrap testing against GIN and XGBoost baselines; confirmed zero label contamination.

claim: GNN prioritization significantly outperforms static sink heuristics, flow centrality, and random ranking.
evidence: VulnGNN Top-1 of 49.81% vs Random of 5.05% (+886% lift) and vs Static Sinks of 5.53% (+801% lift); MRR of 0.6460 vs Static Sinks of 0.1570 (+311% lift).
independent_verification: Independently evaluated across 579 vulnerable graphs and confirmed consistent across all optimization levels (-O0 through -Os).

claim: VulnGNN demonstrates statistically superior vulnerability localization compared to tabular ML (XGBoost).
evidence: VulnGNN achieves statistically significant gains over XGBoost in Top-5 Hit Rate (+6.08% [95% CI: +3.06%, +9.33%]), PR-AUC (+4.57%), ROC-AUC (+1.76%), and Clean Binary FPR (-39.13%). However, Top-1 Hit Rate (-3.98% [95% CI: -8.48%, +0.35%]) and MRR (-0.0084 [95% CI: -0.0394, +0.0222]) cross zero.
independent_verification: 10,000 paired bootstrap resamples on identical test binaries confirm statistical parity on Top-1/MRR, with significant advantages on Top-5 candidate retrieval and false positive suppression.

claim: VulnGNN vulnerability representations generalize seamlessly to unseen software repositories and projects.
evidence: Project-held-out evaluation across 12 completely unseen repositories yields severe degradation: macro F1 drops to 0.1573 ± 0.1138, macro ROC-AUC drops to 0.7769 ± 0.0633, and clean binary FPR spikes to 93.75% ± 20.73%.
independent_verification: Zero-overlap repository partitioning confirms severe domain shift; models overfit to codebase-specific idioms and conventions.

claim: GNN guidance provides execution runtime speedup over unguided DFS and non-learned heuristics.
evidence: Paired 69-binary benchmark under strict 15.0s budget shows Guided requires 328.23s (mean 4.757s) vs DFS 309.33s (mean 4.483s), yielding a 0.94x speedup ratio (Guided is 6% slower in wall-clock time). Paired RMST difference is +0.2121s [95% CI: -0.3461s, +0.7446s]. 4-way ablation shows Static Heuristic (95.66s) and Random (96.30s) explore faster than GNN (96.64s).
independent_verification: Rerun under strict wall-clock SIGALRM supervision confirms GNN priority queue overhead negates marginal state reduction (5.41%). GNN guidance does not prune exponential state space.

claim: Formal Z3 solver satisfiability proves confirmed exploitability and eliminates false positives.
evidence: All 10 SAT witnesses in patched Juliet control binaries are confirmed False Positives caused by unconstrained caller registers (reg_x30) or synthetic memory models; native replay confirms all 10 terminate cleanly with exit code 0. Only 5 of 26 reachable SAT findings yield live memory corruption or command execution.
independent_verification: Individual audit of solver path constraints confirms path feasibility does not imply vulnerability satisfiability under valid concrete program inputs.

claim: Privacy-preserving federated learning enables multi-organization collaborative training over real binary CFGs.
evidence: FedProx (mu=0.002) over 5 non-IID silos (3,604 training binaries) recovers 91.3% of centralized Top-5 hit rate (78.40% vs 85.89%) and achieves 0.9218 ROC-AUC with an ultra-compact synchronization payload of 997.26 KB per client per round (zero raw binary or CFG transfer).
independent_verification: Simulation tests pass on real lifted CFG graphs; communication bandwidth is 255,299 float32 parameters (<1 MB).

claim: NeuroZ3 synthesizes working exploits for stripped binary vulnerabilities verified via native execution.
evidence: Concrete marker execution is demonstrated on cwe78_command_injection.bin (evaluated subshell arithmetic ((40000+1337)) -> 41337). 4 binaries produce reproducible SIGSEGV crashes. However, full ROP chain synthesis is impeded by system mitigations (ASLR, NX, Stack Canaries).
independent_verification: Native differential execution validates command injection and 4 crash bugs against benign control inputs.

claim: The system operates effectively on stripped Mach-O and ELF binaries without symbol tables or relocations.
evidence: Binary loader parses stripped headers via cle, constructs interprocedural CFGs, lifts to VEX IR, and extracts 40-dimensional graph features across 5,150 stripped binaries.
independent_verification: 33 test cases in test_all.py confirm symbol-independent feature extraction, CFG lifting, and vulnerability classification.
